chapter: Inside the Basie rhythm section and band family
title: The band as a happy family
summary: The band got along despite varied personalities and had a ball.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, listen, let's get away from the rhythm section just for a moment --
-- and let's get to the band itself as -- not only musically, but as what it was -- the way it was. You know, with a bunch of strange and marvelous guys -- (laugh)
(laugh) Listen, we got on -- we really got along well.
We were just like -- with all the different personalities we were just like a happy family.
We really -- that's the way we lived.
And, we tried to keep it that way.
I mean you had a good time, didn't you?
Oh, we had a ball. We really did.
